meta.name: arize-ai-provider-integration
meta.description: INVOKE THIS SKILL when creating, reading, updating, or deleting Arize AI integrations. Covers listing integrations, creating integrations for any supported LLM provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Vertex AI, Gemini, NVIDIA NIM, custom), updating credentials or metadata, and deleting integrations using the ax CLI.
